name: Hilkiah
overview: Hilkiah is a significant biblical figure associated with the priesthood and Levitical service during pivotal moments in Israel's history. Notably, as high priest during King Hezekiah's reign, Hilkiah discovered the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord and entrusted it to the scribe Shaphan, sparking spiritual renewal (2 Chronicles 34:14-15). Additionally, the name Hilkiah appears among Levites and priests who served in the post-exilic community, including those who supported Ezra's ministry and participated in temple worship under Jeshua (Ezra 7:1; Nehemiah 8:4; 12:7, 21). These references highlight Hilkiah's enduring role in preserving and promoting the covenant faith among God's people.
